Crypt oracle
Reads read-only health and provenance from fixed services and timestamps each observation.
Crypto servant
Runs an owner-approved operational checklist and reports exceptions.
Worker
Serves a bounded API or computation endpoint.
Bot
Performs a deterministic task such as a format or checksum check.
Agent
Reviews operational evidence and records proposed follow-up for an owner.
Crypto trader
Records a paper-trade scenario and calculates its result from entered values.
Crypt owner
Controls custody policy, access permissions, and recovery approvals.
DMSP
Maintains provider-side telemetry and incident response.
DIT
Owns internal asset records, signing policy, and recovery documentation.
Cryptozoologist
Documents a sighting and grades the available evidence.
